glosses: Designating or reinforcing a reflexive (direct) object or the regime of a preposition
Occasionally representing other pronouns, e.g. ourselves, or translated according to the referenced indefinite subject

examples.text: Rien de tel que chez soi.
examples.en: There is no place like home.

examples.text: Se connaître soi-même n'est pas simple.
examples.en: To know oneself is not easy.
